thread:
Maya: Heads up — Mariner Labs just signaled expansion. Two new teams (DataOps + Legal NLP) want onboarded, and they mentioned batch embeddings + realtime summarization. Renewal in ~32 days, they said budget is flexible if we can meet latency/cost targets. :eyes:
Ethan: Nice. Do we have current token/embedding usage for them? ballpark additional capacity?
Priya: Current monthly tokens ~1.2B, embeddings ~18M. They expect +50-80% embeddings volume from analytics batch jobs and a steady stream of summaries during business hours (9-6 PST).
Jules: So likely a throughput bump on embeddings and more steady-gen traffic. Recommend Dedicated pilot + enablement run for the DataOps team. Can we quantify expected GPU hours?
Oliver: Quick calc — if they move 80% of embedding jobs to us and run 2x nightly batches, that's ~15-20 GPU-hours/day on A100-equivalent for small models; with quantized models could be 6-8 GPU-hours/day. For realtime summaries (low latency), another 2-3 A100 hours peak. Rough total ~10-25 GPU-hours/day depending on quantization and batching.
Maya: They care about predictability more than raw performance. Asked explicitly for per-route cost and latency SLOs for the Legal team (PII redaction pipeline).
Samir: Can do a tailored per-route SLO doc + cost calculator. I'll draft a short runbook for them and include guidance on prefix caching for summaries to cut tokens.
Ethan: I'll take model/quantization recommendations. Suggest starting with a 2-week Dedicated pilot with autoscaling disabled, fixed pool sized for their peak to prove SLA. Then we can show cost delta with/without quantization.
Priya: Also capture enablement: they want an onboarding workshop (2 sessions) + a data pipeline review. Can someone from Solutions run the first workshop next Wed?
Jules: I can run the workshop. I'll prepare a 90-min session covering API patterns, batching, embedding tradeoffs, SDK snippets, and a short lab for their infra team.
Maya: Ops Bot created ticket CS-3421 and linked to customer workspace: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-3421 :white_check_mark:
Ops Bot: CS-3421 created — "Mariner Labs: DataOps + Legal NLP expansion — Dedicated pilot ask". Owner: Maya. Priority: High.
Samir: I'll add the per-route SLO template to the ticket and a suggested rollout plan (canary -> full). Also logging/audit checklist for Legal's compliance team.
Ethan: One more ask — can we offer one week of free Dedicated capacity or credits to accelerate the pilot? That often helps renewals.
Maya: Sales is open to credits but needs ROI story. I'll sync with AM and provide expected cost delta based on Oliver's numbers.
Jules: After the workshop, we should collect a short feedback form with two eval prompts: perceived latency and alignment of cost estimates. Priya, can you own the feedback capture?
Priya: Yep — will create a quick form and hook it to CS-3421.
Oliver: I'll produce the cost/provisioning spreadsheet and drop in the ticket by EOD tomorrow.
Maya: Great — plan: (1) run workshop next Wed (Jules) (2) ops/runbook + SLOs (Samir) (3) quantization & pilot plan (Ethan + Oliver) (4) credits ask from AM. Update CS-3421 with any blockers.
Ethan: Sounds good. I'll also prep a minimal config snippet for Dedicated pool sizes to paste in the runbook:```yaml
pool_size: 4
instance_type: a100-80gb
autoscale: false
max_seq_len: 2048
quantization: int8
```
Maya: Thanks all — let's aim to have the pilot proposal and cost numbers ready for the renewal check-in next week. :thumbsup:
